extension.description: Common Services and Classes for all the cloud drive addons.
שירותים ושירותים משותפים לכל התוספים של כונן הענן.
extension.news:
v1.5.9 released Oct 17, 2026: - Videos and music start and seek faster: connections to Google Drive, OneDrive and Dropbox are kept open between requests
v1.5.8 released Oct 17, 2026: - Subtitle and picture names no longer show %20-style codes in Kodi
v1.5.7 released Oct 16, 2026: - Use as a source: files open through the add-on's local download service, so Google Drive and Dropbox files play (they need a token a redirect can't carry), and OneDrive's links stay out of the Kodi log - Use as a source: folder names with spaces or other special characters work
v1.5.6 released Oct 16, 2026: - Faster library exports for add-ons that can list a whole folder tree at once (Google Drive, Dropbox) - Using an add-on as a source no longer fails on pages requested twice - Database retries stop when Kodi shuts down
v1.5.5 released Oct 14, 2026: - Requests to the sign-in server report the add-on, Kodi and Python versions, for its anonymous usage statistics
v1.5.4 released Oct 12, 2026: - Accounts and caches are stored as JSON, and a locked database is retried instead of failing - Plugin URLs can only run the add-on's own actions - Kodi 17 (Krypton) code removed; sign-in flow and error messages reorganized - Music files without tags no longer log a warning
v1.5.3 released Oct 11, 2026: - The local streaming and source services no longer write every request to the Kodi log as an error
extension.disclaimer:
This cloud drive addon uses a third-party authentication mechanism commonly known as OAuth 2.0. If you want to know more about OAuth 2.0 you can visit the following pages: - https://oauth.net/2/ - https://developers.google.com/identity/protocols/OAuth2 - https://docs.microsoft.com/en-us/onedrive/developer/rest-api/getting-started/msa-oauth
Kodi and myself take no responsibility or liability whatsoever.
The authentication server URL is specified in Settings / Advanced / Sign-in Server. The Sign-in Server implements the OAuth 2.0 protocol. The complete source code of the Sign-in Server can be download here: https://github.com/cguZZman/drive-login You can clone the project and host it in your own server.
